newsitem.title: UK: LME moves to daily metal stock reporting from Apr.
newsitem.headline: LME moves to daily metal stock reporting from Apr.

text.p: The London Metal Exchange (LME) is to move to daily reporting of its warehouse stocks from Monday, April 7.
In a notice to members the LME said the decision was made by the Board and the change would be for an initial period of six months.
Stock movements in and out of the LME warehouses in Europe, the U.S., Singapore, and Japan are currently reported at 0900 London time on Tuesday and Friday.
"Save for the change from twice-weekly to daily reporting all other reporting procedures for warehouses remain unchanged," the LME said.
